mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 3% YoY signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If CPIAUCSL YoY growth > 3% does not lead to negative 20-day forward returns in > 40% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% in one month signals a weakening labor market, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE rises > 0.5% in 1 month does not lead to negative 5-day forward returns in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A significant drop in Real Final Sales (RSAFS) by more than 1% MoM signals a contraction in consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If RSAFS drops > 1% MoM does not lead to negative 20-day forward returns in > 50% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in Industrial Production Index (INDPRO) by more than 2% YoY signals strong economic activity, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO YoY growth > 2% does not lead to positive 60-day forward returns in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals a loosening monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS decreases do not lead to positive 20-day forward returns in > 60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of rising unemployment (UNRATE) and falling nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) signals a weakening labor market, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE rises and PAYEMS falls do not lead to negative 20-day forward returns in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in housing starts (HOUST) combined with a decrease in real final sales (RSAFS) signals a contraction in both housing and consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If HOUST and RSAFS both decline do not lead to negative 60-day forward returns in > 50% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: During a period of economic expansion, a rise in industrial production (INDPRO) coupled with a low unemployment rate (UNRATE < 4%) signals strong economic fundamentals, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO rises and UNRATE < 4% do not lead to positive 20-day forward returns in > 70% of triggered instances.
